The most common Fuji mistake isn't the weather. It's booking the cheapest non-refundable room weeks ahead for a mountain that may simply not show up on the day. The fix takes one click 👇

🔗 Every time and price we checked is on this page 👉 https://japanbystation.com/kawaguchiko-cloudy-fuji-forecast

❌ THE MISTAKE

💳 Same hotel, same night (Wed 16 Dec, twin): ¥13,561 prepaid with no changes, or ¥14,910 with breakfast and free cancellation until the day before.

🤔 That ¥1,349 is what flexibility costs. When Fuji is the reason for the trip, it's the cheapest insurance you'll buy.

✅ THE FIX, IN 4 STEPS

1️⃣ Book the refundable rate and note the free-cancellation date.

2️⃣ Book trains, not buses, if your dates may move: JR East allows one free change before departure.

3️⃣ The evening before, check the forecast and Yamanashi's official live Fuji cameras.

4️⃣ Still cloudy and no spare day? Go anyway, with an indoor plan: the Itchiku Kubota Art Museum (¥1,500, last entry 16:00 in winter) and a bowl of hoto (¥1,210).

🌫️ Grey days have their own mood at the lake: the water goes silver, the far shore softens, and the museum garden of lava stone and spring water doesn't need a view at all.

🚌 The 1-day bus pass (¥1,500 in the Jorudan app) covers the Red, Green and Blue sightseeing lines, so you can still jump to the north shore if the cloud lifts after lunch.

💡 Already booked a night at the lake? Keep it. You get a second look at Fuji the next morning.

👉 Matcha by a garden waterfall for the grey-day plan:
